intro: Windows 10 and 11 come with numerous telemetry and data collection features enabled by default. Winhance gives you back control over your data and improves your system's security posture.

groups.Security: Core Windows security settings including User Account Control, remote access, and system maintenance.
groups.Content Delivery & Advertising: Control promotional content, suggested apps, and advertising throughout Windows.
groups.Lock Screen: Settings related to the Windows lock screen behavior and content.
groups.General: Core privacy settings for advertising ID, language tracking, and personalization.
groups.Speech: Settings for speech recognition and voice-based services.
groups.Inking and typing personalization: Settings for inking and typing personalization features.
groups.Diagnostics & Feedback: Settings for telemetry, diagnostic data collection, and feedback to Microsoft.
groups.Activity History: Settings for Windows activity history and timeline features.
groups.Search permissions: Settings for Windows Search behavior and cloud integration.
groups.App Permissions: Control which system features apps can access.
